name: tico-os
description: Personal portfolio toolkit for taking apps from idea to live: an idea pipeline (new-idea with Inbox quick capture, evaluate-idea, graduate-idea), adopt-project for existing apps, launch-retro, and a portfolio report, wired to proj-incubator and two GitHub Project boards (the Hub and Fordsoft Development); new-project-setup with mobile/web variants and starter files; extract-pattern; house rules loaded at session start; research subagents (market-researcher, idea-critic, Haiku-pinned tico-cheap).
